description: Defines inline functions to build various error indication messages used in the ocudu::fapi namespace, based on specific error codes and message types.

methods.name: build_error_indication
methods.description: Builds a generic error indication message with specified slot, message type ID, and error code ID.

methods.name: build_out_of_sync_error_indication
methods.description: Builds an error indication message specifically for OUT_OF_SYNC errors, including expected slot.

methods.name: build_invalid_sfn_error_indication
methods.description: Builds an error indication message for MSG_INVALID_SFN errors, including expected slot.

methods.name: build_msg_error_indication
methods.description: Builds an error indication message for MSG_SLOT_ERR errors.

methods.name: build_msg_tx_error_indication
methods.description: Builds an error indication message for MSG_TX_ERR errors, with message type TX_DATA_REQUEST.

methods.name: build_msg_ul_dci_error_indication
methods.description: Builds an error indication message for MSG_UL_DCI_ERR errors, with message type UL_DCI_REQUEST.
